answers.core: This feature requires interfacing with how editor scripts are loaded, which is likely impossible with an asset library.
answers.workaround: It is possible to work around this by making every script that could potentially be accessed by an editor plugin into a tool script. However, this then requires adding checks to all editor callbacks to prevent those scripts from changing themselves when the scene is loaded in the inspector. This introduces additional boilerplate, potential performance reductions from a high quantity of "am I in the editor" checks, and most importantly, creates a pathway for destructive bugs if a script is marked as a tool and the check is missed.

title: Add a `@tool_accessible` annotation to access script properties without initializing callbacks
